claim: Patchline ships a living related-work comparison regenerated from a shared, frozen benchmark harness. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the living related-work claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make living-related-work-comparison-gate`.
